# LoneScale

## Summary

Learn how to use the LoneScale node in n8n.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.lonescale.md

---

Learn how to use the LoneScale node in n8n. Follow technical documentation to integrate LoneScale node into your workflows.

Use the LoneScale node to automate work in LoneScale and integrate LoneScale with other applications. n8n has built-in support for managing Lists and Items in LoneScale.

On this page, you'll find a list of operations the LoneScale node supports, and links to more resources.

{% hint style="info" %}
**Credentials**

Refer to the [LoneScale credentials documentation](/integrations/builtin/credentials/lonescale) for authentication information for this node.
{% endhint %}

## Operations <a href="#operations" id="operations"></a>

* List
  * Create
* Item
  * Create

## Templates and examples <a href="#templates-and-examples" id="templates-and-examples"></a>

## Related resources <a href="#related-resources" id="related-resources"></a>

Refer to [LoneScales documentation](https://help-center.lonescale.com/en/articles/6454360-lonescale-public-api) for more information about the service.

n8n provides a trigger node for LoneScale. Refer to the [LoneScale Trigger node documentation](/integrations/builtin/trigger-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.lonescaletrigger) for more information.

### What to do if your operation isn't supported <a href="#what-to-do-if-your-operation-isnt-supported" id="what-to-do-if-your-operation-isnt-supported"></a>

If this node doesn't support the operation you want to do, you can use the [HTTP Request node](/integrations/builtin/core-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.httprequest) to call the service's API.

You can use the credential you created for this service in the HTTP Request node:

1. In the HTTP Request node, select **Authentication** > **Predefined Credential Type**.
2. Select the service you want to connect to.
3. Select your credential.

Refer to [Custom API operations](/integrations/builtin/custom-api-actions-for-existing-nodes) for more information.
